elevation_prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: render-locked architectural facade source for a LEGO-compatible 3D detached-house family
Input image: the attached catalogue image is the hard identity and construction reference. Do not redesign the villa.
Primary request: Create a precise, photorealistic, rectified orthographic FRONT ELEVATION of the exact same Spanish Colonial villa. Preserve exactly three occupied levels in the long main house, the left bell tower rising one partial level above it, the low-pitched terracotta tile roof, deep central arched stone portal, central wrought-iron balcony, smaller Juliet balconies, recessed wood sash windows with black iron security grilles, warm aged ochre stucco, irregular exposed-brick patches, pale fieldstone side/base zones, and the tower's two tall arched openings with a visible bronze bell. Show the full building from ground line through every roof ridge and tower cap with both end edges visible.
Scene/backdrop: isolated on a neutral warm-grey studio field, no ground plane beyond a thin datum line.
Style/medium: highly detailed architectural material reference, photorealistic but shadow-neutral.
Composition/framing: true straight-on orthographic elevation, centered, generous margin, no perspective convergence or three-quarter view.
Lighting/mood: broad diffuse overcast studio illumination; no directional sunlight, trees, cast shadows, scenery reflections, or haze.
Materials/textures: hand-trowelled warm sand/ochre lime stucco with restrained age variation; localized real red-clay brick exposure; pale rough limestone; deep-set dark timber windows; black forged-iron bars and balconies; weathered red terracotta barrel tiles; bronze bell.
Constraints: exactly three main occupied levels; keep the asymmetrical left tower, entrance/balcony axis, window and grille rhythm, roof pitch and exposed-brick placement hierarchy; no text or signage.
Avoid: generic box, Italian Renaissance redesign, extra floors, symmetric second tower, flat roof, modern curtain wall, oversized arches, trees, fountain, people, vehicles, street, neighbours, perspective, dramatic shadows, watermark.
occupied_depth_prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit
Asset type: registered occupied-depth plate for physical glazing in a LEGO-compatible Spanish Colonial villa
Input image: the attached rectified villa elevation is the exact canvas and coordinate authority.
On the exact same canvas, remove every exterior material and silhouette element: all stucco, exposed brick, stone, roof tiles, tower walls, iron grilles and balcony rails, exterior window/door frames, portal surround, bell, cornices, steps, side wings, and background. Retain ONLY localized interior content visible behind the existing windows, balcony door, deep central entrance, and tower arch openings: dark room depth, restrained warm rooms, curtains, shallow floor slabs, the deep shadowed entry vestibule, and open dark sky/depth behind the bell arches. Keep each retained region precisely inside its original opening position and size.
Backdrop: perfectly uniform black everywhere outside the registered interior regions.
Lighting: realistic residential variation; some rooms dim, some softly warm; entrance and tower arches remain dark and spatial, never luminous.
Constraints: preserve exact pixel dimensions, canvas, three occupied main levels, tower openings, window/door registration, widths, heights, mullion alignment, and portal arch. Do not move, resize, add, merge, or delete openings.
Avoid: exterior wall material, brick, stucco, stone, iron, roof, bell, scenery, reflections, text, perspective change, extra windows, uniform orange glow, watermark.
